# Project alignment

For a meaningful change, read the relevant canonical references:

- [Project overview](../../docs/reference/project-overview-and-current-state.md)
- [Vision and wand hardware](../../docs/reference/vision-and-wand-hardware.md)
- [Wand NFC data contract](../../docs/reference/wand-nfc-data-contract.md)
- [System architecture](../../docs/reference/system-architecture-and-data-flows.md)
- [Build and operations](../../docs/operations/developer-build-and-deploy.md)
- [Documentation maintenance](../../docs/operations/documentation-maintenance.md)
- [Repository router](../../AGENTS.md)

Use the repository invariants in `AGENTS.md` and the path-specific instruction file for the area being changed. Connect the change to a user outcome, preserve the offline hunt loop, and update the canonical source before its pointers.

For documentation changes, use [documentation.instructions.md](documentation.instructions.md) and [documentation-maintenance.md](../../docs/operations/documentation-maintenance.md).
